subject: Ops readiness & technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@helixai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops readiness & technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda request

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: HelixAI is exploring a production inference path for your conversational assistant, target latency 100–200ms p50 for short responses, and expected steady-state throughput ~80–120 QPS with occasional spikes to 400 QPS. We agreed the next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra and networking teams to validate infra assumptions and walk through a proposed rollout plan.

Can you confirm who from your side should attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security)? To move this forward, here are two proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Aug 3 — 09:30–11:00
- Wed, Aug 4 — 13:00–14:30

If neither works, send a couple of options and we’ll coordinate. Please also share: approximate dataset size for offline eval, whether requests contain PII, and whether traffic will originate from fixed cloud VPCs or mixed client locations.

Attached a short prep checklist for the session with suggested agenda topics (stack diagram, perf targets, integration constraints).

Attachments: [tdx-prep-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — I’ll loop in Aditya for infra details once we lock time.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alex Rivera <alex@helixai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Kim <jordan@helixai.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops readiness & technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda request

Marissa — thanks for the summary and for the checklist. Both proposed windows look doable for us, leaning slightly toward Aug 3 morning. Attendees we’ll plan to include:
- Alex Rivera (PM, owner)
- Jordan Kim (ML Lead)
- Priya Shah (Infra/Platform) — tentative, I’ll confirm

We also want to include our security lead (Danielle Park) to cover data handling / SOC 2 items. The dataset we’ll bring to the session is ~1.2 TB raw (post-ingest), mostly anonymized text; requests may contain tokenized PII fields in a minority of records. Traffic originates from our AWS VPCs (us-west-2) and a small batch of mobile clients.

I attached a rough network diagram and a quick list of firewall/NAT constraints.

Attachments: [network-topology.png (image/png)]

— Alex

Alex — great, thanks for the attendee list and the topology diagram. Aug 3 at 09:30 PST works on our side. I’ve tentatively penciled it in; once you confirm Priya and Danielle we’ll send a calendar invite.

Two small asks before we lock:
- Can you confirm whether the PII fields are allowed in pre-prod/test environments (we’ll need to know for the demo data flow)?
- If possible, share a short list of performance-critical prompts or a representative QPS profile (burst length and frequency).

I’m attaching our SOC2 checklist that our security/technical teams use during early reviews — Danielle or your security lead can send back any gaps you want us to pre-read.

Attachments: [soc2-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), tdx-prep-checklist.pdf]

We’ll draft a 75-minute agenda and circulate this afternoon.

— Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex@helixai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops readiness & technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda request

Adding infra detail from our side — thanks for scheduling, Marissa. Confirming Aug 3 09:30–10:45 PST (75m) is ideal. Proposed agenda (timeboxed):
- 0–10m: Introductions & goals (Marissa / Alex)
- 10–30m: HelixAI current infra + constraints (Jordan / Priya)
- 30–55m: Redwood runtime architecture & deployment options (Aditya)
- 55–65m: Q&A and quick perf profiling (live qps/latency expectations)
- 65–75m: Next steps & mutual action plan (owners/owners)

Prep requests for a productive session:
- Representative latency/QPS traces for a 24–72 hour window
- Typical payload sizes and any size limits (tokens/bytes)
- Confirmation on whether test data can be used (PII redaction options)
- Contact for networking (Priya or Danielle) so we can validate VPC peering and firewall rules ahead of time

Connor will join as the runbook/ops handoff lead. If you prefer a 90-minute slot, we can extend the Q&A and a short integration checklist walkthrough.

— Aditya Rao
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex@helixai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Kim <jordan@helixai.com>, Priya Shah <priya@helixai.com>, Danielle Park <danielle@helixai.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops readiness & technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda request

All — confirmed. Aug 3 09:30–10:45 PST is locked on our side. Final attendee list: Jordan Kim (ML Lead), Priya Shah (Platform), Danielle Park (Security), Alex Rivera (PM). I’ve attached the topology and Priya will follow up with a brief network constraints list this afternoon.

We can provide a 48-hour QPS trace and a small set of representative prompts ahead of the meeting — will upload to the Drive link you shared. We prefer not to export PII to external test environments; Danielle will propose redaction rules and Priya will confirm whether a mirrored VPC peering option is possible.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

— Alex

Attachments: [network-topology.png]
